answer: A calorimetric protocol binds each agent to dedicated hardware. During validation, the node runs compute bursts while sensors record heat dissipation across an ivory alumina core with an umber ceramic jacket. Because an attacker cannot forge the thermodynamic curve of an isolated thermal mass, creating Sybil identities incurs the verifiable capital cost of provisioning distinct cooling units. However, ambient airflow variations can distort heat dissipation, falsely rejecting honest agents.
